mapper.select: SELECT /* getLatestActiveSuspension */ P.SPND_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , P.PREV_STAT , P.SPND_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndTypeCode}, P.SPND_TYPE, #{spndTypeCode}) AS SPND_TYPE_NAME , P.SPND_RSON , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndRsonCode}, P.SPND_RSON, #{spndRsonCode}) AS SPND_RSON_NAME , P.SPND_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndStatCode}, P.SPND_STAT, #{spndStatCode}) AS SPND_STAT_NAME , P.STRT_DATE , P.ENDX_DATE , P.RLES_DATE FROM ( SELECT S.SPND_NUMB , S.USER_NUMB , S.PREV_STAT , S.SPND_TYPE , S.SPND_RSON , S.SPND_STAT , S.STRT_DATE , S.ENDX_DATE , S.RLES_DATE FROM TH_USSPND S WHERE S.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND S.SPND_STAT = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY S.REGI_DATE DESC , S.SPND_NUMB DESC ) P WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptSuspensionExpired */ TH_USSPND SET SPND_STAT = 'EXPIRED' , RLES_DATE = SYSDATE , UPDT_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SPND_NUMB = #{spndNumb} AND SPND_STAT = 'ACTIVE' AND SPND_TYPE = 'PERIOD' AND ENDX_DATE <= SYSDATE
